verdict.rationale: The Editor API is documented as a way to automate the Editor, explicitly including asset management, and the plans list REST API access. The MCP server can modify project data programmatically, playcanvas-sync maps project assets to the local file system, and SplatTransform is a CLI/library for batch-converting and processing splat data. Together these allow scripted pipelines, but the evidence shows no import-time hooks or import presets that process incoming assets automatically. Missing for 10: documented import hooks/callbacks, per-asset-type import presets or settings templates, a concrete example of an automated batch import pipeline for general assets (meshes/textures), and hands-on corroboration.
